text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Hello, this is Aston Machan.
Here is Aston Machan and the paddock.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Today, the skies over Machan are clear.
The clouds drift lazily, and the sea is calm.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
In other words, it's good.
Machan will do her best.
Please watch closely, okay?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: ...Wink.

The paddock stirs with excitement at her entrance.
...Meanwhile, the restless crowd has
one other topic on their minds.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: "Did you see Vodka and Daiwa Scarlet's race in the Tulip Sho!?"

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
I saw it! I had an awesome spot right in front of the goal post,
and it was seriously amazing!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Will it be Vodka, or will it be Daiwa Scarlet?!
It's a duel down the stretch between the two!

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text:
Haaaaaaaaahーー!
Uwooooooooーー!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
—Vodka in the lead, Vodka takes first across the line!
Daiwa Scarlet finishes in second!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Hell yeahhhhhh!!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Hehe! Sorry 'bout that, Scarlet!
First place is mine today!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
............
――Alright, next.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Today was just a preliminary skirmish!
There were things I learned from running out there!!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
The real stage where I drag you down
will be the upcoming Oka Sho...!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Just what I wanted!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
"Right~?!
I got super curious after that and looked into it,
and get this—we're in the same class AND room!"

text_block_list.name: Spectators A & C
text_block_list.text: Wait, really!?

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Since both were head and shoulders above the rest,
they've stood out to each other ever since enrolling.

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Both of them are fiercely competitive, so that only made it worse,
sparking a rivalry over who was number one.

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
“As we battle it out, both of our skills
keep leveling up together~... kinda like that!”

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
I seeee...
You two really are great rivals, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text: I'm getting super excited for the next Oka Sho~!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Things are... heating up.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: *Achoo*... *sniff*.
